THE BASICS

Pick up.
Throw down.

PLAYER 01

AD move W jump / flutter S crouch

PLAYER 02

←→ move ↑ jump / flutter ↓ crouch

K fire L grab / throw O call Enter strafe

One hit. One point. Start unarmed, pick up the glowing equipment, and outlast everyone else. Empty gun? Throw it and grab another. Grenades detonate after being thrown and can hurt their owner. Hold jump to flutter. A rising tide ends long rounds.

Controllers: left stick / D-pad move · south button jump · west button fire · north button grab / throw · east button call · left bumper strafe. Players 3 and 4 need controllers; use the first two connected pads for them in four-player mode. Escape pauses. Click the game before playing. Desktop keyboard or controller required.
